headline._: So far today: a vendor reports 25 servers rooted, with no victim named and no evidence shown. Still no organisation confirms a compromise.
headline.exec: Still no organisation says it was hit. One vendor reports 25 servers rooted, unverified. CISA's deadline for US agencies is today.
headline.general: Nothing changes for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Dream Research reports 25 servers rooted (three in an unnamed US government-affiliated environment), no victim, no evidence: a report, not a confirmed compromise. KEV deadline today.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: A vendor's report of 25 rooted servers names no victim and shows no evidence; one outlet says it is unverified. Keep it apart from "confirmed hacked".
headline.researcher: 685 sources by 07:14 UTC. One vendor report (Dream Research) added to the compromise ledger, not counted as confirmed.

items.text: A vendor, Dream Research, reports that a campaign rooted 25 servers, three of them in an unnamed US government-affiliated environment, on 26 October. It names no victim and publishes no evidence; The Next Web says it has not verified it. The newsroom carries it as a dated, attributed report, not a confirmed compromise.
items.before: 2 vendor claims of success, both withdrawn
items.src: Dream Research via The Hacker News, The Next Web; the journalist (state v6), the correspondent

items.text: "Has anyone actually been hacked through php2shell?" gets a dated update: still no organisation confirms a compromise.
